audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 fits 49.46% over 746 games with Pantheon owning stages 1 through first item and Rumble only taking two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike and the mid block treat Grand Skyfall as a repeatable roaming threat, and no ultimate cooldown is given.
audit.why: The ability is called Grand STARFALL, and at 180 seconds at rank 1 it is one of the longest ultimates in the game — a single baited or wasted cast buys you three minutes of a Pantheon who cannot cross the map. Calling it 'the global threat' without the number makes it feel permanent.
audit.corrected: Correct name used and the 180-second rank-1 cooldown stated in mid and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page invents a Pantheon passive that blocks auto-attacks, and repeats it five times: 'he blocks your auto harassment with his passive Aegis', 'Stack passive Aegis to block your auto-attack poke', 'his passive blocks your autos', 'his passive reset means he wins extended exchanges', 'his percent-damage passive blocks one auto'.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will — every few spells or attacks his NEXT spell is empowered. It blocks nothing. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E), a 22-second channel that makes him invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT only. Conflating the two costs the player the single decisive interaction in this lane: Flamespitter is a 600-range cone you aim, so if you walk around to his flank or behind him while Aegis Assault is channelling, your entire Q lands and his 22-second cooldown is spent for nothing. The page instead teaches that autos are simply blocked and Flamespitter is 'your only reliable poke'.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will named as the empower passive, Aegis Assault named as the 22-second frontal-invulnerability channel, and the walk-behind-the-shield line added to early, late, whys and wants.foe[1].
sources: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json (P Mortal Will; E Aegis Assault: 'invulnerable to damage from the front', channel, cd 22/21/20/19/18)

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is the tracked cooldown everywhere but is only described as 'a short cooldown'.
audit.why: 13 seconds at rank 1 down to 9 at rank 5 is the whole rhythm of the lane, and Aegis Assault's 22 seconds is the longer, more punishable hole nobody mentioned.
audit.corrected: Both numbers added to the cooldown breakdown and the level 2-3 spike.
sources: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json (W Shield Vault cd 13/12/11/10/9; E Aegis Assault cd 22/21/20/19/18)

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike and the late block call the item 'Liandry's Tempest'.
audit.why: No such item. Every other panel on the page, including the full layer, correctly says Liandry's Torment — the player cannot buy what the page names.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Liandry's Torment in both places.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Don't entry 'Sit low for his W execute'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a dash, a stun and an attack-attack reset — it has no execute. The player is told to fear the wrong ability at low health.
audit.corrected: Retitled to the real mistake: standing in front of the Aegis Assault channel.
sources: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json (W Shield Vault: dash, hardCC, autoReset)

edits.before: Pantheon is stronger than you at every pre-6 level — his Shield Vault stuns on demand and his empowered Comet Spear hits for a genuine chunk before your W shield can respond. At level 1 he blocks your auto harassment with his passive Aegis, so Flamespitter cone damage is your only reliable poke; commit to a Q and back out before he can W-stun you into a full combo. At level 2 he can stun-into-spear-burst for real, so never walk forward without tracking his W cooldown. At level 3 your double Harpoon arrives — use the first E to bait his W, then land the second slow after his stun whiffs to disengage safely. Accept the disadvantage, keep the wave frozen near your tower, and farm through the pressure.
edits.after: Pantheon is stronger than you at every pre-6 level — his Shield Vault stuns on demand and his empowered Comet Spear hits for a genuine chunk before your W shield can respond. His block is Aegis Assault, a 22-second channel that only stops damage from the front — walk around to his flank and the whole Flamespitter cone lands on him anyway. At 2 he can stun-into-spear-burst for real, and Shield Vault is 13 seconds at rank 1 — never step up without tracking it. At level 3 your double Harpoon arrives — use the first E to bait his W, then land the second slow after his stun whiffs to disengage safely. Accept the disadvantage, keep the wave frozen near your tower, and farm through the pressure.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he still has the edge — his passive blocks your autos and his burst combo is on a short cooldown, but his window to kill you shrinks if you manage Heat correctly and keep his W on cooldown. W-shield pre-emptively when he runs at you; the shield eats a surprising chunk of his empowered spear if it procs. At level 6 his Grand Skyfall is the global threat: ward the river lantern side, track the R cast animation on the minimap, and have your W ready for the landing radius. If he roams bot, immediately shove the wave into tower and look to fire Equalizer across mid or bot lane — your R travels instantly and can neutralise the gank before he ever lands. You are not winning this 1v1 yet, but you are not losing the map.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he still has the edge — Mortal Will empowers every third spell and Shield Vault is only 13 seconds, but his window shrinks if you manage Heat and bait that stun out. W-shield pre-emptively when he runs at you; the shield eats a surprising chunk of his empowered spear if it procs. At 6 Grand Starfall is the global threat, but it is 180 seconds at rank 1: ward river, track the cast on the minimap, and once it is spent you own three minutes of map. If he roams bot, immediately shove the wave into tower and look to fire Equalizer across mid or bot lane — your R travels instantly and can neutralise the gank before he ever lands. You are not winning this 1v1 yet, but you are not losing the map.

edits.before: Once Liandry's Tempest is complete, Pantheon's raw early-game identity stops carrying — his defensive passive is now on a long charge timer and your Danger Zone Flamespitter outlasts anything he can do in a sustained fight. Force fights in tight jungle corridors where he cannot kite backward from your Q cone, and place Equalizer across the path of any collapse rather than directly on a target. At two items the power gap flips fully: his percent-damage passive blocks one auto, but your entire rotation deals magic damage he has no MR for, and Equalizer alone ends teamfights. Keep him off carries with double Harpoon slows and let the burn do the work while your team follows up.
edits.after: Once Liandry's Torment is complete, Pantheon's early-game identity stops carrying — Aegis Assault is a 22-second channel that only covers his front, and your Danger Zone Flamespitter outlasts him in any sustained fight. Force fights in tight jungle corridors where he cannot kite backward from your Q cone, and place Equalizer across the path of any collapse rather than directly on a target. At two items the power gap flips fully: Mortal Will only empowers his next spell, and your entire rotation is magic damage he has no MR for, and Equalizer alone ends teamfights. Keep him off carries with double Harpoon slows and let the burn do the work while your team follows up.

edits.before: Pantheon's W point-click stun into empowered Q burst is the kill threat — one stun into full combo before you can W-shield deletes a third of your bar.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a point-click dash, stun and auto-attack reset on 13 seconds at rank 1 — the wind-up on the reset auto is your cue to step back, not the cast itself.

edits.before: Your Liandry's Tempest spike means sustained Q damage in Danger Zone finally outruns Pantheon's early lead — this is your first clean fight window.
edits.after: Your Liandry's Torment spike means sustained Q damage in Danger Zone finally outruns Pantheon's early lead — this is your first clean fight window.

edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — 13s at rank 1, a dash, a stun and an auto reset. Kite it. - Aegis Assault: 22s, and it only blocks his FRONT — flank it. - Grand Starfall: 180s at rank 1.

notes: Aegis Assault also makes Pantheon untargetable per the kit flags, but Riot's own description only says invulnerable to damage from the front, so I wrote only what the description supports. The _missing-interactions entry 'Rumble can deny your mobility (Shield Vault, Grand Starfall) with Scrap Shield, The Equalizer' is half wrong: Scrap Shield creates no terrain and denies nothing — that is a derived-flag misfire on Rumble's kit — while The Equalizer genuinely does wall off a Shield Vault angle. I only used the Equalizer half. Whether Comet Spear executes low targets is not in the kit data, so no execute claim was made anywhere.
